outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially closed (frame 0, left_ego_image). The robot approaches the upper door handle, then draws the door outward and downward: separation from the oven body is visible by frames 120–130 in image and left_ego_image. The door remains visibly angled open at frames 200–230, although it is not lowered fully horizontal. No failed acquisition, unwanted object displacement, or harmful side effect is established.
